data.title: 夜莺 · 点心盘
data.description: 她把饼干整齐地排在盘里，给你留了最喜欢的那一块。
data.action: 把点心盘推到桌子中央
data.promptProse: Seated across an intimate round table set with vintage porcelain teacups, Nightingale offers a small floral plate of almond biscuits toward the viewer with a shy, heartwarming smile. Steaming chamomile tea, silver teaspoons, and afternoon sunbeams warming the linen tablecloth create a comforting, restorative tea-time atmosphere.
data.animaCaption: Seated across a linen-draped table set with steaming porcelain teacups, she gently pushes a floral plate of almond biscuits toward the viewer with a shy, warm smile. Afternoon sunbeams brighten the comforting tea setting.
